# Corvix Agency & Ecosystem - Full Technical Overview

## Agency Overview
Corvix is a full-service custom software development, AI engineering, and corporate formation agency headquartered with primary regional focus in Austin, Texas. We build end-to-end digital infrastructure for founders, VC-backed startups, and mid-market enterprises.

## Technical Stack & Architecture

### Web Engineering
- **Frameworks**: Next.js 16 (App Router, Server Actions, Partial Prerendering), React 19, Vue 3, Laravel, Django.
- **Styling & Motion**: Tailwind CSS v4 (Zero-runtime CSS), GSAP 3 (ScrollTrigger), Three.js (WebGL interactive visualizers), Framer Motion.
- **Performance Standard**: Sub-second Largest Contentful Paint (LCP), 0.0 Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS), 100% Core Web Vitals pass rate.

### AI Engineering & LLM Orchestration
- **RAG Infrastructure**: Vector embedding pipelines, Hybrid Search, PGVector, Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant.
- **LLM Models**: OpenAI GPT-4o, Anthropic Claude 3.5 Sonnet, Google Gemini 1.5 Pro, Llama 3 local inference.
- **Agent Workflows**: Autonomous task decomposition, ReAct loops, tool/API execution, function calling, agentic state machines.

### Mobile Engineering
- **Cross-Platform**: React Native, Flutter.
- **Native Security**: Biometric authentication, Keychain/Keystore encryption, offline state persistence, background sync, WebSocket streaming.

### Corporate Legal & Business Setup
- **Entity Formation**: Texas LLC formation, Wyoming LLC formation, Delaware C-Corp setup.
- **Tax & Compliance**: IRS EIN processing (Form SS-4), Texas Franchise Tax compliance, BOI filings, Banking Resolution documentation.

## Regional Specialization: Austin, Texas (Silicon Hills)
